data.long_meaning: A name of Persian origin, derived from the Persian word 'khakashan' meaning 'giver'. In Islamic tradition, the name is often given to those who bring good news and spread positivity. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kehkashan usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
